zh-CN.headlineFact: 台风落地、停火试探、AI透明加码
zh-CN.headlineView: 世界在应急、信任与规则间寻找落点
zh-CN.headlineFull: 台风落地、停火试探、AI透明加码；世界在应急、信任与规则间寻找落点
zh-CN.intro: “努尔”登陆后逾80万人转移，Google签署欧盟AI生成内容透明准则，一人公司方法论进入标准化课程。柏林骄傲节袭击、俄乌互袭、美伊暂停攻击、法国农药争议与奥林匹斯山入遗，显示安全与开放都需要可执行的边界。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的韧性，是把风险预警、透明规则和社会修复接成一套系统。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 未来感不只在飞船，也在每条能落地的护栏。

en-US.headlineFact: A typhoon lands, attacks pause and AI transparency advances
en-US.headlineView: the world looks for workable boundaries between emergency, trust and rules
en-US.headlineFull: A typhoon lands, attacks pause and AI transparency advances; the world looks for workable boundaries between emergency, trust and rules
en-US.intro: More than 800,000 people relocated after Typhoon Noul's landfall, Google signed the EU code for AI-content transparency, and solo-business operations entered a standardized curriculum. Berlin's Pride attack, Russia-Ukraine strikes, the U.S.-Iran pause, France's pesticide dispute and new UNESCO listings all show that safety and openness need enforceable boundaries.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Real resilience connects risk warnings, transparent rules and social repair into one system.
en-US.doudouQuote: The future is not only spacecraft; it is every guardrail that works.

sources.title: Google is signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content

zh-CN.headlineView: 广东安全转移人数升至逾80万
zh-CN.headlineFull: 台风“努尔”登陆后减弱；广东安全转移人数升至逾80万
zh-CN.intro: 台风“努尔”登陆华南后减弱为热带风暴，但沿海仍面临强风与暴雨。美联社援引新华社称，截至周日广东已有超过80.1万人转移，灾害管理从登陆预警转入积水、山洪与交通恢复阶段。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 风力下降不等于风险归零，灾后第一天更考验基层恢复能力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 台风走慢了，排水和复工不能走快了。

en-US.headlineFull: Typhoon Noul weakens after landfall; relocations in Guangdong rise above 800,000
en-US.intro: Typhoon Noul weakened to a tropical storm after making landfall in southern China, but strong winds and heavy rain continued. AP, citing Xinhua, reported that more than 801,000 people had been relocated in Guangdong as emergency work shifted toward flooding, landslides and transport recovery.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Lower wind speeds do not erase risk; the first day after landfall tests local recovery capacity.
en-US.doudouQuote: The storm has slowed down, so drainage and reopening should not speed up.

sources.title: Typhoon Noul makes landfall in south China's Guangdong

zh-CN.headlineFact: Google签署欧盟AI内容透明准则
zh-CN.headlineView: 水印开始走向跨平台互认
zh-CN.headlineFull: Google签署欧盟AI内容透明准则；水印开始走向跨平台互认
zh-CN.intro: Google宣布签署欧盟《AI生成内容透明行为准则》，并推动C2PA与SynthID等技术协同。公司称正与Apple、OpenAI、NVIDIA等伙伴推进可互操作水印，同时警告重叠标签可能增加用户理解成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI透明的下一步不是多贴标签，而是让不同平台认可同一套来源证明。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 水印太多也会变成花纹，关键得人人看得懂。

en-US.headlineFact: Google signs the EU code for AI-content transparency
en-US.headlineFull: Google signs the EU code for AI-content transparency; watermarking moves toward cross-platform recognition
en-US.intro: Google signed the EU Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content and linked the effort to C2PA and SynthID. It said it is working with Apple, OpenAI, NVIDIA and others on interoperable watermarking, while warning that overlapping labels could increase confusion.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The next step in AI transparency is not more labels, but a provenance signal recognized across platforms.
en-US.doudouQuote: Too many watermarks become wallpaper; the point is that people understand them.

sources.title: Google is signing the EU AI Act Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content

zh-CN.headlineFact: SCORE推出“一人六位数企业”公开课
zh-CN.headlineView: 单兵增长被拆成可复制系统
zh-CN.headlineFull: SCORE推出“一人六位数企业”公开课；单兵增长被拆成可复制系统
zh-CN.intro: 美国小企业辅导机构SCORE将于7月30日举办免费线上课程，围绕AI、自动化、自由职业协作、多收入来源与无雇员运营展开。它释放的信号是：一人公司正在从个人天赋叙事转向可学习的标准化运营栈。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司不是一个人做完全部，而是把有限注意力交给正确的系统。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 不招人也能长大，前提是别让老板本人变成唯一接口。

en-US.headlineFact: SCORE offers a One Person Empire course
en-US.headlineView: solo growth is being broken into a repeatable system
en-US.headlineFull: SCORE offers a One Person Empire course; solo growth is being broken into a repeatable system
en-US.intro: U.S. small-business mentoring group SCORE will host a free July 30 webinar on AI, automation, freelancers, multiple income streams and operating without employees. The signal is that solo entrepreneurship is shifting from a talent story to a teachable operating stack.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A one-person company is not one person doing everything; it is scarce attention assigned to the right systems.
en-US.doudouQuote: You can grow without hiring, but not if the founder remains the only interface.

sources.title: Find upcoming events: One Person Empire

zh-CN.headlineFact: 柏林骄傲节袭击致1死多人伤
zh-CN.headlineView: 开放城市需要更细密的公共安全设计
zh-CN.headlineFull: 柏林骄傲节袭击致1死多人伤；开放城市需要更细密的公共安全设计
zh-CN.intro: 柏林骄傲节附近发生车辆冲撞与持刀袭击，造成1人死亡、多人受伤。德国当局将事件按疑似极端主义恐袭调查；嫌疑人在警方行动中死亡。市民随后举行悼念和声援活动。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 保护多元社会，既要抵抗仇恨，也要把大型公共活动的安全设计做得更具体。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 自由不是没有护栏，而是护栏不替你决定该爱谁。

en-US.headlineFact: Berlin Pride attack leaves one dead and many wounded
en-US.headlineView: open cities need more detailed public-safety design
en-US.headlineFull: Berlin Pride attack leaves one dead and many wounded; open cities need more detailed public-safety design
en-US.intro: A vehicle-ramming and stabbing attack near Berlin's Pride festival killed one person and wounded many others. German authorities treated it as suspected extremist terrorism; the suspect later died in a confrontation with police. Residents gathered for memorials and solidarity.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Protecting a diverse society means resisting hate and designing large public events for concrete risks.
en-US.doudouQuote: Freedom needs guardrails, but the guardrails do not decide whom you may love.

sources.title: Anschlag im Umfeld des Christopher Street Day

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国与伊朗连续两夜暂停攻击
zh-CN.headlineView: 短暂停火为谈判换来窗口
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国与伊朗连续两夜暂停攻击；短暂停火为谈判换来窗口
zh-CN.intro: 美国和伊朗在连续升级后均暂停攻击。美方称给谈判“留一点空间”，地区调停方将此视为降级的积极信号；但霍尔木兹海峡商业航运仍处三周低位，核问题与通航安排尚未解决。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 停火不是终点，却是把军事节奏重新交还给外交的必要间隙。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先把按钮放下，才听得见桌对面在说什么。

en-US.headlineFact: The U.S. and Iran pause attacks for two nights
en-US.headlineView: a brief halt creates room for negotiations
en-US.headlineFull: The U.S. and Iran pause attacks for two nights; a brief halt creates room for negotiations
en-US.intro: The United States and Iran both paused attacks after days of escalation. Washington said it was giving talks some space, and a regional mediator called the halt a positive signal. Commercial traffic in the Strait of Hormuz remained at a three-week low, while nuclear and transit issues stayed unresolved.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A pause is not peace, but it is the interval needed to hand the rhythm back to diplomacy.
en-US.doudouQuote: Put down the button first; then you can hear the other side of the table.

sources.title: US pauses attacks on Iran for a second day as peace talks continue

zh-CN.headlineFact: 俄军导弹与无人机袭击乌克兰多地
zh-CN.headlineView: 城市防空仍在消耗战中承压
zh-CN.headlineFull: 俄军导弹与无人机袭击乌克兰多地；城市防空仍在消耗战中承压
zh-CN.intro: 俄军周日袭击基辅、哈尔科夫与扎波罗热等地，造成至少2人死亡、多人受伤；基辅市中心附近楼宇因残骸起火。俄方则称拦截133架乌克兰无人机，双方远程打击继续扩大基础设施风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当拦截数量成为日常，防空资源、预警时间与民用恢复都进入长期消耗。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 天空没有前线标线，城市却每天都在交作业。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：战争与安全。

en-US.headlineFact: Russian missiles and drones strike Ukrainian cities
en-US.headlineView: urban air defenses remain under attritional pressure
en-US.headlineFull: Russian missiles and drones strike Ukrainian cities; urban air defenses remain under attritional pressure
en-US.intro: Russian attacks hit Kyiv, Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia on Sunday, killing at least two people and wounding others; falling debris started fires near central Kyiv. Russia said it intercepted 133 Ukrainian drones as long-range strikes on both sides widened infrastructure risk.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When interception counts become routine, air defenses, warning time and civilian recovery enter a long war of attrition.
en-US.doudouQuote: The sky has no front-line markings, but cities sit the exam every day.

sources.title: 2 dead in Ukraine from Russian attacks, 4 more in Russian-held area hit by Ukrainian drones

zh-CN.headlineFact: 法国放宽两种禁用农药豁免
zh-CN.headlineView: 农业救急与授粉生态正面碰撞
zh-CN.headlineFull: 法国放宽两种禁用农药豁免；农业救急与授粉生态正面碰撞
zh-CN.intro: 法国议会通过措施，允许食品与环境安全机构在特殊情况下批准啶虫脒（acetamiprid）与flupyradifurone用于困难作物。养蜂人与环保团体担忧授粉昆虫和生物多样性承受长期代价。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 农业政策不能只算当季产量，也要把授粉、水土与长期生态服务写进账本。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 救一季收成，别把下一季的蜜蜂一起透支。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：环境与农业。

en-US.headlineFact: France opens waivers for two banned pesticides
en-US.headlineView: farm relief collides with pollinator protection
en-US.headlineFull: France opens waivers for two banned pesticides; farm relief collides with pollinator protection
en-US.intro: French lawmakers approved a measure allowing the food and environmental safety agency to grant exceptional waivers for acetamiprid and flupyradifurone in struggling crop sectors. Beekeepers and environmental groups warn of long-term harm to pollinators and biodiversity.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Farm policy must count pollination, water, soil and long-term ecosystem services, not only this season's yield.
en-US.doudouQuote: Save one harvest, but do not borrow next season's bees.

sources.title: French beekeepers' fury at lifting of pesticides ban
After adoption of contested agriculture law, all eyes turn to Constitutional Council

zh-CN.headlineFact: 奥林匹斯山与诺曼底登陆海滩入选世界遗产
zh-CN.headlineView: 自然与记忆共同被保护
zh-CN.headlineFull: 奥林匹斯山与诺曼底登陆海滩入选世界遗产；自然与记忆共同被保护
zh-CN.intro: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产委员会将希腊奥林匹斯山、法国诺曼底登陆海滩列入名录。奥林匹斯山以自然与文化双重价值获认可，希腊为此筹备12年；历史现场也被纳入长期保护框架。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 遗产保护不是把过去封存，而是让自然、神话与历史继续参与今天的公共生活。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 山不会自己讲故事，人类得负责把它讲久一点。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：文化与自然遗产。

en-US.headlineFact: Mount Olympus and the D-Day beaches join the World Heritage List
en-US.headlineView: nature and memory receive shared protection
en-US.headlineFull: Mount Olympus and the D-Day beaches join the World Heritage List; nature and memory receive shared protection
en-US.intro: UNESCO's World Heritage Committee added Greece's Mount Olympus and France's D-Day landing beaches to the list. Olympus was recognized for both natural and cultural value after a 12-year Greek campaign, while the historic beaches entered a long-term protection framework.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Heritage protection does not freeze the past; it lets nature, myth and history remain part of public life.
en-US.doudouQuote: Mountains do not tell their own stories; people must help them last.
